title: Server Applications
description: Software that belongs to this server rather than to a customer. Each one runs as its own account on a port the panel reserves, and stays closed at the firewall until you open it.

installed.title: Installed
installed.none: No server application is installed yet.
installed.firewallNote: Ports {{min}} to {{max}} are reserved for these applications and dropped at the firewall. Opening one here is what makes it reachable from outside the server.

catalog.title: Available
catalog.manualPort: This application reads its port from its own configuration file, so set the reserved port there yourself.

install.confirmBody: {{name}} {{version}} will be downloaded, checked against its recorded checksum and started under its own account. Its port stays closed at the firewall until you open it.

remove.confirmBody: The account, the files and the unit are deleted. The data directory is archived first, but nothing else is kept.

firewall.confirmBody: Port {{port}} becomes reachable from the internet for {{name}}. An address you have blocked by country or by ban is still refused.
firewall.failedTitle: The firewall rule was not changed

error.load: The server applications could not be read.
error.install: The application could not be installed.
error.remove: The application could not be removed.
error.action: The application did not respond to that.
error.firewall: The firewall rule could not be changed.

reason.host_app_unknown: This server does not offer that application.
reason.host_app_disabled: That application is not offered on this server.
reason.host_app_no_build_for_architecture: The project publishes no build for this server's processor.
reason.host_app_no_checksum: There is no recorded checksum for this download, so it cannot be verified.
reason.host_app_checksum_mismatch: The download did not match its recorded checksum and was discarded.
reason.host_app_already_installed: That application is already recorded on this server.
reason.host_app_no_free_port: Every port in the reserved range is in use.
reason.host_app_bad_start_command: The catalog's start arguments cannot be used.
reason.host_app_invalid_catalog_entry: The catalog entry is not usable.
reason.host_app_unpack_failed: The archive could not be unpacked.
reason.host_app_binary_missing: The archive does not contain the program where the catalog says it does.
reason.host_app_port_taken: That port is already in use.
